extracted.name: Way-Too-Easy Steak Marinade
extracted.description: A great steak marinade with honey using items you likely have on-hand, such as soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and brown sugar. Fast and easy!
instruction_lines: Whisk soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, honey, brown sugar, and onion powder together until the sugar is completely dissolved into the liquid.
